item.title: Recover Lost WordPress.com Access
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’ve lost access to my WordPress.com account and the usual password-reset route is blocked because I can’t recall the email address I used during registration. What I do have is the public URL of the site and the username that appears on posts, so we have some solid reference points to prove ownership. The blog is still live and publicly visible, but I’m locked out of the dashboard.
I need a specialist who knows the WordPress.com recovery workflow inside out—contacting Automattic support, preparing ownership proofs (DNS, post content, billing lookup, or any other recognised method), and guiding or handling the entire ticket until I can sign in again with a fresh email and password. Clear, step-by-step updates are essential so I always know where we stand with support.
Deliverable: • Working WordPress.com login credentials (or verified recovery link) tied to an email I control, plus a brief outline of the steps you took so I can reference them in future.
Once I’m back inside the account, the project is complete.

item.title: Elegant Wellness Website Design
item.description:
30-250 CAD | Project: Luxury Website Design – Stillhaven Wellness Inc.
I'm seeking a talented website designer with experience creating sophisticated, high-end spa, beauty, or wellness websites.
Stillhaven Wellness Inc. is a boutique wellness business in Ontario, Canada, specializing in Authentic Japanese Head Spa experiences and Personalized Scalp Care.
My Vision
I want a website that immediately conveys luxury, tranquility, relaxation, and exclusivity. The aesthetic should be elegant, intimate, warm, and slightly moody, with sophisticated typography, beautiful imagery, and seamless navigation.
Think luxury wellness retreat rather than a traditional hair salon or generic spa website.
What I Already Have
- Established business name, logo, and branding - Registered domain: stillhavenwellness.ca - Partially completed Canva website - Service menu and treatment descriptions in development - Clear vision for the overall aesthetic
Website Requirements
- Beautiful, professional homepage - Treatments and services section - About Stillhaven / Our Philosophy - Online booking button linking to an external booking platform - Contact information and social media links - Fully mobile-responsive design - Basic SEO optimization - Ability to easily update content myself
I'm open to improving my existing Canva website or exploring another platform if it would significantly improve the final result.
What I'm Looking For
Someone with a strong creative eye who can transform my vision into a polished, visually stunning website that reflects the premium experience Stillhaven Wellness will offer.
Please provide examples of luxury spa, beauty, or wellness websites you've personally designed, your proposed approach, estimated completion timeline, and pricing.
I look forward to reviewing your portfolio!

item.title: Pay-Walled Live Stream Integration
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to turn my existing website into a venue where visitors can purchase one-time access to a live stream. The site is already up; what it lacks is a secure paywall and a smooth viewer experience.
Here’s what I need you to handle:
• Recommend and configure the streaming platform that best fits a pay-per-event model—whether that ends up being YouTube Live, Vimeo Live, or another service you trust. • Build the payment flow so users complete a single transaction (Stripe or PayPal are fine) and are then granted immediate, automated access to the live player. • Embed the player neatly into my current site, locking the event behind the paywall and preventing direct URL sharing. • Provide a simple way for me to schedule future events with the same workflow.
I’ll supply site credentials, branding assets, and test content. Your work is complete when I can run a private dry-run: I pay, the video appears for me, and it stays protected from non-payers.

item.title: AWS Website Migration & SEO Preservation
item.description:
250-750 USD | Website Migration, Domain Restructuring & AWS Infrastructure Setup – sanaco.com.sa to sana.com.sa
Project Overview We are looking for an experienced Website Migration Specialist / AWS Cloud Architect to manage a website migration and infrastructure restructuring project.
Our existing website, sanaco.com.sa, is currently hosted on Amazon AWS Lightsail. The website has a database exceeding 150 GB and contains substantial business content, products, categories and SEO-optimised pages.
Management has decided to use sana.com.sa for the existing website content and business activities, while retaining sanaco.com.sa for a different business purpose with separate content and functionality.
We need an experienced professional to plan and execute this migration without losing existing website data, SEO value, organic search visibility or business functionality.
Project Objectives Migrate the existing website from sanaco.com.sa to sana.com.sa. Preserve all existing products, categories, website content, images and relevant database records. Protect the SEO investment made on 268 optimised product pages. Implement appropriate 301 redirects from the old domain to the new domain. Retain sanaco.com.sa and prepare it for a completely different website and business purpose. Establish an efficient, secure and scalable AWS hosting architecture. Minimise website downtime and avoid data loss during migration. Scope of Work 1. Existing Website and Infrastructure Audit Analyse the existing website architecture. Review the AWS Lightsail hosting environment. Identify the website technology, programming language and database engine. Audit the existing database (150+ GB). Analyse website files, media storage, plugins and integrations. Identify unnecessary database records and technical issues. Evaluate the existing server's performance and resource utilisation. 2. Website Migration to sana.com.sa Create the new production environment for sana.com.sa. Migrate the existing website application and required files. Migrate the database and associated media. Preserve products, categories, attributes, variations and relevant business records. Preserve customer and historical transaction data where required. Configure domain DNS, SSL and server settings. Test all website functionalities before launch. 3. SEO Preservation and Migration SEO preservation is a critical requirement of this project.
We have already completed SEO optimisation for 268 products on sanaco.com.sa.
The selected freelancer must ensure:
Preservation of existing product URLs wherever possible. Migration of all SEO titles and meta descriptions. Preservation of product descriptions and headings. Preservation of image ALT tags and relevant image assets. Preservation of structured data and schema markup. Correct canonical tag configuration. Updated internal linking structure. Updated XML sitemap. Updated robots.txt configuration. Individual 301 redirects from old URLs to corresponding new URLs. No unnecessary redirect chains or redirect loops. Verification of Google Search Console and indexing configuration. All 268 SEO-optimised products must be checked after migration.
Important: Redirecting all old URLs to the new homepage will not be accepted. Redirects must point to relevant equivalent pages.
4. Repurposing sanaco.com.sa After migrating the existing website to sana.com.sa:
sanaco.com.sa must remain operational. The domain will be used for a different business purpose. The new website must have an independent application and content structure. The new website must have a separate database. Historical URLs from the old website must continue to redirect appropriately to their corresponding pages on sana.com.sa. The new website must not interfere with the existing SEO migration strategy. 5. AWS Infrastructure and Database Optimisation We are open to recommendations regarding the best AWS architecture.
Potential technologies include:
AWS Lightsail Amazon EC2 Amazon RDS Amazon S3 Amazon CloudFront AWS Route 53 AWS Backup Amazon CloudWatch The freelancer should recommend whether to:
Retain and optimise the existing Lightsail infrastructure. Move to EC2 and RDS. Implement another cost-effective AWS architecture. The two websites should have independent applications and databases, even if they share appropriate AWS infrastructure.
The proposed solution must consider security, scalability, performance, backup and disaster recovery.
6. Testing and Quality Assurance Before final deployment, the freelancer must verify:
All 268 SEO product pages. Product images and media files. Product categories and variations. Website navigation and internal links. Forms and integrations. Customer accounts and historical records where applicable. Database integrity. SSL certificates. Website loading speed. Mobile responsiveness. HTTP status codes and redirects. Google indexing and sitemap configuration. 7. Post-Migration Support The freelancer should provide post-launch technical support to resolve migration-related issues.
We also require documentation of:
New AWS architecture. Database migration procedure. Website deployment process. Backup and recovery procedures. DNS and domain configuration. Redirect mapping. Technical handover documentation. Expected Deliverables Technical audit report of the existing website. Recommended AWS infrastructure architecture. Fully migrated website on sana.com.sa. Independent website infrastructure for sanaco.com.sa. Migrated database and website files. SEO migration and URL redirect mapping. Verification report for all 268 SEO-optimised products. Performance and security testing report. AWS configuration and technical documentation. Post-migration support. Required Freelancer Skills We are looking for a professional with proven experience in:
AWS Lightsail. Amazon EC2 and RDS. MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL, as applicable. Large database migrations (100 GB+). Website domain migrations. SEO migration and 301 redirects. Google Search Console. Website performance optimisation. Cloud infrastructure and server administration. Database backup and disaster recovery. Experience with complex production website migrations is highly preferred.
Important Project Requirements Experience with large databases is mandatory. SEO migration experience is essential. The freelancer must provide a clear migration strategy before implementation. Full backups must be taken before any production changes. The migration must be tested in a staging environment. No existing website data should be deleted without approval. Website downtime should be kept to a minimum. All website and infrastructure credentials must be handled securely. All project work and documentation must be handed over upon completion. What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide the following information when submitting your bid:
Describe your experience migrating websites with databases exceeding 100 GB. Have you previously migrated websites between two domains while preserving SEO rankings? What AWS architecture would you recommend for this project? How would you handle the migration of the 150+ GB database? How would you preserve the SEO value of 268 optimised product pages? What is your estimated project timeline? What is your estimated total project cost? What post-migration support do you provide? We prefer freelancers who can demonstrate previous successful projects involving AWS infrastructure, large database migration and SEO-preserving domain migration.

item.title: Fashion E-Commerce & Wholesale PWA
item.description:
750-1500 AUD | I distribute several premium clothing brands and now need a single platform that sells to two groups—regular online shoppers and my network of approved wholesale retailers. The project covers three tightly connected areas:
• Public retail store: shoppers must be able to browse by brand, colour and size, add items to a cart, pay securely with cards and digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), and track delivery from dispatch to doorstep on any desktop browser, iPhone or Android device. • Wholesale portal: only logged-in, pre-approved retailers see wholesale pricing, view upcoming collections, and place bulk orders or pre-orders. Each retailer needs a clean order history section. • Admin dashboard: I and my team must control every data point—brands, SKUs, images, retail vs. wholesale pricing, separate stock levels, customers, agents, orders, invoices and basic analytics.
Key requirements – Build as an installable Progressive Web App first; native wrappers later can be discussed. – Separate inventory pools for retail and wholesale so consumer orders never eat into reserved wholesale stock. – One codebase responsive to desktop, tablet and mobile with a premium, minimalist look. – PCI-compliant checkout, SSL throughout, automatic tax and shipping calculations, email/SMS notifications, and PDF invoice generation. – Full source-code ownership and unrestricted administrator access on hand-over.
When you reply, please outline: 1. Preferred tech stack (frameworks, database, hosting). 2. Estimated timeline with key milestones. 3. Total build cost plus any ongoing licence or support fees. 4. Two or three live fashion or multi-store projects you have led that demonstrate similar complexity.
I’m ready to move quickly once I can see a solid plan that balances performance, scalability and ease of maintenance.

item.title: WordPress College Application Site
item.description:
96-156 CAD | I’m building a new WordPress-powered website for our college and the single most important feature is a smooth online application experience for prospective students. I need a developer who can set up the site, design a clean interface that matches our branding, and create a secure application form that captures:
• Basic personal and contact details • Education history plus the course the student is applying for • Document uploads (certificates, ID, etc.)
Each submission must trigger an email to our admissions team that contains every field and any uploaded files, so nothing slips through the cracks. While alternatives like a private dashboard or downloadable spreadsheets were considered, email notifications are the workflow our staff is comfortable with right now.
You’re free to use tools such as Elementor, Gutenberg, Gravity Forms, WPForms, or similar—whatever delivers a reliable, responsive form and keeps spam at bay. Please ensure the form is GDPR-friendly, works flawlessly on mobile, and can be extended later if we decide to add payment or course-selection logic.
Deliverables: • Fully functional WordPress site hosted on our server • Styled application page and form with validation and upload capability • Email notification setup and tested with real data • Brief hand-off guide (plugin list, how to update fields, etc.)
If you’ve built comparable education or admission portals before, that’s a plus—share a link or two so I can see your approach. I’m ready to move quickly once I find the right fit.

item.title: Security Guard & Yard Management Web App Development - Quotation Request
item.description:
1000-1500 CAD | Please provide your estimated total development price in CAD and estimated completion time for the historical software-development scenario below. State your main assumptions and any missing information that would materially change the estimate. Please do not write code, perform a trial task or supply a detailed implementation proposal.
REFERENCE SCENARIO — historical requirements, not instructions to begin work:
Project Overview We are seeking a skilled and experienced full-stack developer to build a secure, mobile-friendly web application for real-time security and yard management. The application will be the central hub for our operations, used by security guards, customers, and the site owner to efficiently track trucks, trailers, and on-site activities.
The primary goal is to replace our manual processes with a streamlined digital solution for logging truck entry/exit, reporting damages, managing customer schedules, and providing a live, comprehensive dashboard for the owner.
Key Features & Deliverables The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and delivering a fully functional, tested, and documented web application with the following core features:
Guard Portal (Mobile-First UI):
Reporting: A quick-entry form to log truck/trailer numbers, full/empty status, and entry/exit timestamps.
Damage Reports: Ability to submit detailed reports with photo uploads.
Event Log: A section for adding custom notes and event details.
Customer Portal:
Emergency Contacts: Each customer's page must display their emergency contact information.
Visitor Management: Customers can add and delete approved visitors (trucks/drivers) directly.
Real-time Tracking: A live view showing all of the customer's trucks and trailers currently inside and outside the yard, along with their loaded status (full/empty).
Pre-Scheduling: A simple interface for customers to pre-submit scheduled truck/trailer arrivals.
Approval Queue: Customers will have an interface to approve or deny visitor access requests made via QR code.
Owner/Master Portal:
User Management: Functionality to assign guards to specific sites and manage user roles.
Reporting & Analytics: Advanced filtering and export capabilities for all reports.
Real-time Dashboard: A live dashboard showing all vehicles currently in the yard, updated instantly via WebSockets or similar technology.
The QR Code & Access Approval Workflow This is a critical part of the project. The system must support the following multi-step approval process:
A first-time visitor (e.g., a truck driver) will scan a QR code at the property entrance.
The QR code directs them to a secure web form where they can request access.
This request then enters an approval queue that is visible to the relevant customer and the site's security guard.
Both the customer and the guard must be able to manually review and approve or deny the request. Access is not granted automatically.
Upon approval, the guard's portal is updated, allowing them to proceed with the truck's check-in.

item.title: Outbid.lol Clobuild a competitive ranking and claiming platformne With Admin
item.description:
250-750 USD | build a website similar to Outbid.lol, but with addons such as allowing users to post unranked listings. Users can create posts, compete for ranked positions, and claim or take over a position on a public leaderboard.
The idea is to build a competitive ranking and claiming platform. Here's how I would approach it. 1. Website concept The website would allow users to: Create a listing: A user posts something they want to rank. A User could have no account as like outbid.lol if he only to post a ranked listing. if the user wants to post unranked listings or both, he needs to have an account. Claim a position: Other users can claim an available ranking position. Compete for rankings: Users can challenge or outbid the current position holder. Display a leaderboard: Show who currently holds each position (1st to 20th). Listings below 20th are unranked and positioned by random searching. Track activity: Show recent claims, challenges, and ranking changes. Manage profiles: Users have accounts, usernames, and ranking histories.
2. Main website pages Page Features Home Home button, categories button; Register button, Login button, Trending lists and popular rankings 15 or more ranked listing (under :all: category) and randomly drawn listings and related information, such as privacy Explore Browse all public lists Create list Publish a new ranking list List details View positions and claim them Leaderboard Show top-ranked users User profile Claimed positions and history Dashboard Admin panel: manage categories (one level or two levels, the total number of categories is unlimited, theoretically) and fees for ranking Fees for ranked and unranked listings
Poster: Manage your lists and claims Only post ranked listings, no need an account
Image title Ranked /unranked categories position Amount
URL or #candle
Home / cat 1
(pay)
description
A fees table will show Comparing minimum amount for position and the amount user choosing, if user’s amount greater than the minimum amount for the position, the process will proceed Use dodopayments.com as payment processor Should be able to take ApplePay, GooglePay, PayPal, Credit cards, ACH 3. How the ranking system should work
Based on the actual Outbid.lol model, the central mechanic is: A person submits their website, product, or social media profile. They choose how much they want to pay. Higher payments receive higher positions (an increment must be met for a higher position). Anyone can submit a higher bid to climb the leaderboard. If someone increases their own bid, they only pay the difference. Once payment is confirmed, the leaderboard updates automatically. With more higher bidding, the lowered previous bidding will be kept to lower position in order, for example, with 2 higher biddings added on, the initial 10th bidding will be moved down to 12th position, always above unranked listings
For example: Rank Product Total bid #1 Product A $500 #2 Product B $300 #3 Product C $150 #4 Product D $50
If someone bids $550 (suppose the minimum increment is $50), they become #1. Equal bids should be ordered by who paid first. This follows the core ranking model described by Outbid.lol.
If the minimum increment is $20, a user bids $320 will get his listing the #2 position.
A difference from outbid.lol: A poster can submit an unranked listing at a plain fee, for example $10 per month, or at a discounted fee: $100 for a year, and this fee is nonrefundable. Unranked listing can’t be upgraded to ranked listing
4. Recommended technology I'd recommend this stack for a scalable first version: Component Technology Frontend Next.js Design Tailwind CSS Database Supabase / PostgreSQL Authentication Supabase Auth Payments Stripe or another supported payment provider, or use payment processor such as dodopayments.com
Hosting Vercel AI features OpenAI API
Important backend features: Automatic ranking calculations. Secure payment verification through webhooks. Duplicate listing detection. User account management. Bid and payment history. Admin dashboard and moderation. Important: Never update a ranking just because the user clicked Pay. Only update it after verified payment confirmation.
5. Design direction I'd suggest a modern dark interface with: Black or charcoal background. Purple/blue accent colors. Large #1 leaderboard spotlight. Clear bid amounts. Green claim buttons. Live ranking updates. Responsive mobile layout.
How should people claim a ranked position? 1. Ranking / claiming method Paid bidding — users pay to claim or outbid positions, like Outbid.lol. Free claiming — users claim available positions without paying. Both — free listings with paid upgrades to higher positions.
2. What can people post? Websites, products, and AI tools Anything — users create their own lists and rankings People, profiles, and social media accounts Custom categories and user-created leaderboards
the complete website, including frontend, backend, database, payment integration, and admin and poster dashboard.
